title: Update on Seizure of Singapore's Terrex Infantry Carrier Vehicles in Hong Kong
what_it_is: Update on Seizure of Singapore's Terrex Infantry Carrier Vehicles in Hong Kong

sections.label: Questions on Terrex seizure in Hong Kong
sections.summary: MPs asked the Minister for Defence about the Hong Kong seizure of nine SAF Terrex vehicles, equipment exposure, and shipping routes through Chinese ports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Defence (a) whether any confidential or secret equipment and information was compromised or potentially disclosed to foreign powers in the course of the Hong Kong Customs' seizure of nine SAF Terrex ACVs and their associated equipment in November 2016; (b) what new steps are in place to prevent a repeat incident of SAF material being inadvertently exposed and/or withheld overseas; and (c) whether the Ministry can provide an update on the discussions with the Hong Kong authorities to return the vehicles and associated equipment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Defence with regard to the detention of the shipment of nine Terrex Infantry Carrier Vehicles and associated equipment by the HK Customs on 23 November 2016 (a) what steps has the Singapore Government taken to facilitate the return of the vehicles and equipment; and (b) what has been the outcome of the efforts thus far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Defence (a) whether any of our controlled military equipment has previously been shipped on board container vessels on commercial routes which passed through ports in China like Xiamen; (b) whether the Ministry deems the routing of controlled military items through ports like Xiamen to be of acceptable risk; and (c) whether the Ministry intends to review the current contractual arrangements for the commercial sea carriage of our military equipment between Singapore and foreign ports.

sections.label: Cost of commercial shipping arrangements
sections.summary: Commercial arrangements let SAF ship military equipment safely and economically; direct point-to-point shipping would cost three to four times more.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: These commercial arrangements have enabled SAF to ship military equipment safely and economically.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: It would cost three to four times more and add several hundred million dollars to MINDEF's annual budget to ship all military equipment directly from point-to-point.

sections.label: Ownership of detained SAF equipment
sections.summary: The SAF Terrexes and other equipment detained in Hong Kong are the property of the Singapore Government.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The legal position is that the SAF Terrexes and other equipment detained in Hong Kong are the property of the Singapore Government.

sections.label: Request to return Singapore property
sections.summary: Singapore has requested the Hong Kong authorities to return its property immediately.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: Accordingly, we have requested the Hong Kong authorities to return our property immediately.

sections.label: Cost of nine Terrexes
sections.summary: The cost of the nine Terrexes is listed in the shipping manifest at S$30 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: The third question on the cost of the nine Terrexes, it is as listed in the shipping manifest at S$30 million.

sections.label: Communications with Hong Kong and South Korean precedent
sections.summary: Singapore communicated with Hong Kong at various levels, and a similar 2010 seizure of South Korean equipment was later returned.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: We have communicated to the Hong Kong government on a number of occasions, as I have said, at various levels, including the Prime Minister's letter, and I have read to Members their response.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: There was one previous case where there were some similarities, and this was a case where the South Korean's equipment was also seized by the Hong Kong authorities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Ng Eng Hen
sentences.text: This was in 2010, and it was also an armed personnel carrier, as well as a light tank; and it was returned subsequently to the South Koreans.
